feeds.title: Life Part 2 & Beyond Blog
feeds.description: In 2011 Jonathan Look sold everything he owned, took early retirement and began travelling the world. He started this blog to demonstrate to his fellow baby boomers that the world is not some scary place and it is still open and available to those who are motivated and curious enough to go out and see it for themselves.

feeds.title: The Roaming Boomers Blog
feeds.description: We are a Online luxury travel magazine offering destination information, travel news, travel gadget reviews, and more. All delivered with stunning photography and informative videos. Our mission is to inspire you to get out there and explore the wonders of our world.

feeds.title: Hole In The Donut Blog
feeds.description: My name is Barbara Weibel and I'm the person behind Hole in the Donut Cultural Travel. My mission is to Long-term travel to learn about other cultures and bring this information to readers through narrative articles on my travel blog.

feeds.title: My Itchy Travel Feet
feeds.description: At My Itchy Travel Feet, baby boomers will find inspiration and advice to help plan their next adventure. Baby boomers Donna L. Hull and Alan Hull travel the world recording their experiences with words, photos and videos so that you'll know exactly what to expect.

feeds.title: Travel Past 50 Blog
feeds.description: We're Kristin Henning and Tom Bartel. In 2010, we sold our business, our home, our possessions, and gave away our dog.We've been traveling the world ever since. Travel Past 50 offers encouragement, entertainment, and information, with sharp writing, personal tales, and professional photography, for travelers over the age of 50.

feeds.title: Albom Adventures
feeds.description: Living in New Zealand and travelling the world, expat Rhonda Albom takes you on a vicarious adventure as she captures the essence of travel through photography, stories, tips, and humour. She inspires young baby boomers to travel New Zealand and the world.

feeds.title: Travel Notes & Beyond Blog
feeds.description: Information about beautiful vacation spots, good eats, and interesting places around the world written by Anda Galffy. Anda is an Award-winning travel writer and passionate photographer based in Southern California.

feeds.title: Baby Boomster » Travel
feeds.description: Rebecca shares her experience about travelling on her blog along with travel tips, how to deal with unannounced situations, and more. I'm Rebecca a Los Angeles-based travel and lifestyle blogger. I created Baby Boomster for active women over 50 who are not ready for a rocking chair, but ready to ROCK! Ageing is an attitude.

feeds.title: Clark Norton
feeds.description: If you're a baby boomer in your fifties, sixties, or early seventies and love to travel or would love to start travelling, then this blog is for you. I hope to provide inspiration to take those long-awaited trips you've been dreaming about, as well as to offer practical tips to help make them happen.

feeds.title: Retired And Travelling
feeds.description: Linda and David are travel bloggers and photographers - semi retired and travelling everywhere around the world. Having visited over 100 countries, we are sure to have some travel inspiration and great travel tips for you! Retired and Travelling gives us opportunities for scuba diving, luxury cruising, indulging our chocoholic needs, and appeasing our sea and sunshine addictions.

feeds.title: Life Part2 and Beyond Blog
feeds.description: LifePart2 and Beyond is a baby boomer travel adventure blog showing that a life of travel and adventure is available to almost anyone who actively chooses that lifestyle.

feeds.title: Traveling with Sweeney
feeds.description: Catherine Sweeney brings you the best of Europe and North America travel destinations by seizing every travel opportunity she can. She's a boomer woman travel enthusiast with a lifelong passion for going places.

feeds.title: Travel With Kevin And Ruth
feeds.description: Kevin and Ruth Read are based in Cabri, Saskatchewan, Canada but are often seeking out worldly locales that are off the beaten path. Travel with Kevin and Ruth has been online for over fourteen years. The informative diary style of writing keeps readers tuned in to their activities daily.

feeds.title: 5050 Travelog Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to 5050 Travelog, the home of our Camera Reviews and Travel Blog. Find travel tips and see how we completed a bucket list goal and travelled to 50 countries in 50 months after turning 50. Follow our travels through Europe, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Canada, the USA, and New Zealand.

feeds.title: Green With Renvy
feeds.description: Baby Boomer and founder Alison Abbott has been a multi discipline designer for all of her adult life. She is a serious adventurer, content creator and small business strategist, who is enthusiastic about keeping it local whether at home or abroad. Alison shares the experience of eco-friendly travel and lifestyle through Green With Renvy.

feeds.title: Traveling with MJ Blog
feeds.description: Mary Jo Manzanares, aka MJ, is a traveller, travel writer, podcaster, and publisher. When she's not on a trip, she's planning or researching the next one and has a bag always packed, ready for the next great adventure. Her travel ethos is Value Luxury - that sweet spot where experience and price intersect to create WOW.

feeds.title: Nancy D Brown
feeds.description: Planning for a holiday? Before finalizing any place, visit the best travel guide by Nancy D. Brown. Here you will find reviews of destinations she has travelled. Nancy D. Brown is a lover of all things related to travel. With What A Trip, she has combined her passion for travel with her professional writing career.

feeds.title: To Travel Too Blog
feeds.description: To Travel Too is a Baby Boomer lifestyle and travel blog, run by married couple, freelance writers and full-time travellers Jane and Duncan Dempster-Smith. Our goal is to encourage and inspire others to get out of their comfort zones, do those things that you always wanted to do and visit those places that you had always dreamed of.

feeds.title: Linda On The Run
feeds.description: My name is Linda and I am always on the run! I like to call myself an 'original blogger' because I was writing about my travels before the internet was even popular! I have travelled to all 50 states, 10 countries, 7 Canadian provinces and over 30+ countries in the last few years! I specialize in luxury and local travel!

feeds.title: Luggage and Lipstick Blog
feeds.description: I am a Baby Boomer. Not a senior yet, but definitely in mid-life and loving it. And Luggage and Lipstick is my boomer travel blog with loads of tips.

feeds.title: 50 Shades of Age
feeds.description: A lighthearted blog for the 50 somethings about some of the issues that face our age group as we prepare for our golden years.

feeds.title: A Boomer's Life After 50 » Travel
feeds.description: The following section of A Boomer's Life After 50 is dedicated to Travel. Welcome to 'A Baby Boomer Woman's Life After 50.' I'm Judy Freedman, a post-50, or should I say as of 2018, post-60 female baby boomer blogger. My blog is targeted at the millions of baby boomer women (born between 1945 - 1964) who are going through a similar life journey in mind, body and spirit.

feeds.title: Planet Janet Travels Blog
feeds.description: I'm delighted you have stopped by Planet Janet Travels. I'm a globe-trotting Baby Boomer with over 80 countries logged on my passport. I love to share personal stories and photos from my grand adventures to many of our planet's best destinations.

feeds.title: Jam Travel Tips Blog
feeds.description: Personal travel logs with great recommendations and travel tips from destinations around the world from Jam Travel Tips.

feeds.title: Legging It
feeds.description: We are Ron and Michele, an Australian couple from Perth who have decided not to wait until we retire to travel the world but get out there and embrace life while we are still young. We hope our blog inspires you to step out of your comfort zone and do something different to live the life you love be it travel, study, work or your relationships.

feeds.title: One Road at a Time
feeds.description: We are Patti and Abi. After retiring early to live a simpler life, travel the world, and hopefully, inspire others to redefine retirement. We've been traveling through life together for 40+ years, embracing each new chapter and each new adventure with open minds. Our travels have taken us to four continents and to 19 countries. In their blog, they give travel tips for different countries and information about different locations.

feeds.title: Southern Girl Gone Global
feeds.description: Southern Girl Gone Global, a lifestyle/travel blog, is a heart's journey of a single mom, writer, and educator who left her empty Nashville nest to find beauty, adventure, and relationship across 4 continents and the Caribbean.

feeds.title: Seniors with Latitude
feeds.description: Getting older does not coincide with getting 'old.' We're here to raise your frequency (energy level) and inspire you to enjoy your life in whatever way feeds your spirit!

feeds.title: Trips & Travels of Grandma
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Carol Starkey. Years of travel with business and pleasure, I am writing blogs for you, to assist you, both in preparation for your journey and fears that we share as a wiser generation. Giving you suggestions, tips, encouragement and motivation.

feeds.title: TravelnWrite
feeds.description: TravelnWrite is about chasing a daydream and catching it. We are Jackie and Joel Smith, boomer ex pats from America's Pacific Northwest who decided to grow olives in Greece instead of old at home. Through this blog, we hope to inspire you to go after your dreams.

feeds.title: Sand In My Suitcase Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Sand In My Suitcase! This blog is about luxury travel (splurge and affordable). We're Janice and George Mucalov, lawyers by profession, now travel writers. Exploring exotic and close-to-home places. The wonder of discovering different cultures. Tasting the world via food and wine. Dreaming where to go next.

feeds.title: Contented Traveller
feeds.description: Paula and Gordon of Contented Traveller, are Destination & Experience Marketers. This is a travel blog sharing how to get the best experiences when you travel; because you have worked hard and you've earned it.

feeds.title: Dare2go
feeds.description: dare2go is the overland travel blog, written with regular tourists & overlanders in mind. We share our life on the road, beautiful photos, and advice from our experiences.

feeds.title: Not Dun Roamin
feeds.description: Travel blog with ideas, information & reviews for the older, active traveller - from Australia to Zululand!

feeds.title: Grey Globetrotters
feeds.description: Covers tips, information and ideas for your mid-life travel adventures. Grey Globetrotters is your gateway to affordable luxury over 50s travel written by a fearless grey globetrotter, with 40+ years of experience in international travel, the blog is all about gathering rich new experiences in midlife, through slow, sustainable travel.

feeds.title: Possess The World
feeds.description: We are Cath and Ian, an Aussie couple who love food, wine and travelling. Over the last 5 years we have traveled together, starting with a few weeks at a time until 2017 when we are travelling for 12 months. This is our travel blog to inspire you to take up travelling independently. Subscribe us for tips and tales from our travels to help and inspire you to Possess the World.

feeds.title: Roxie on the Road
feeds.description: Roxie on the Road is about journeys of Two Fifty-Somethings. Roxie Yonkey is a 'Roxie on the Road' travel blogger. Blogging combines her passions for travel, history, photography, writing, and design. Follow to get more updates from this blog.

feeds.title: Boomeresque
feeds.description: Boomeresque is a forum for posts and discussions about Baby Boomer Travels for the Body and Mind.

feeds.title: Home Free Adventures
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Lynne and my husband, Tim and I said goodbye to our surprised children and quizzical friends in 2011. We travelled light, had an appetite for new experiences and had the savvy and flexibility to make ourselves at home in almost any situation. We have lived in Mexico, Argentina, Turkey, France, Italy, England, Germany, Portugal, and Morocco.

feeds.title: I'm Retired -- Adventures of a Simpler Life
feeds.description: Adventures of a Carolina-based retired teacher, Cynthia, who loves to travel at home and abroad. Reading, Snowshoeing, Cross Country Skiing, Hiking, Biking, and Living with Vintage Things are some of her other interests.

feeds.title: The Baby Bloomer Blog
feeds.description: The Baby Boomer is a place for women who travel or who dream of traveling. We share funny and inspiring stories, ideas for solo/friend/group travel, advice about where to go, and reminiscences for Boomer women and those who love them.

feeds.title: The Simple Adventures Of Sue & Lee Ann » Travel
feeds.description: We are living a simple but happy retirement together. We enjoy travel, learning, laughing, fitness and a great-grandchild.

feeds.title: Joe and Josee's Journey
feeds.description: Just an ordinary couple living an extraordinary lifestyle! In 2014 we decided to sell everything we owned to embark on a Journey to discover the world. After a five year overland expedition through the Americas driving from Alaska to Argentina, we traded our truck for two backpacks... Let's see where the wind takes us this time!

feeds.title: Sensational Baby Boomers
feeds.description: Both called Anne, we have been friends for more than 40 years. We created this site because we firmly believe that our 60s are our new 40s - we still love fashion and style, relish clothes shopping, adore travelling and enjoy feeling good for our ages.

feeds.title: Baby Boomer Budget Traveler
feeds.description: In 2017 we decided to change our lives and cast away the 9 to 5 routine that had guided our lives for the past forty-some years. Our mission is to motivate individuals within the baby boomer generation to travel the world. Moreover, to experience other cultures, explore the history and be nourished by flavorful & exotic foods. All the while, journeying on a minimalistic budget.

feeds.title: Loving Life on the Go
feeds.description: We are Rick and Deb, two Canadian retired travellers. We added this travel blog to the mix so we could share our adventures, cultural experiences and tips. We also document our attempt to travel full-time on a budget.

feeds.title: Otts World Travel Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Sherry Ott and Otts World is my journey from traditional cubicle to digital nomad to travel expert. I inform and amuse you on the topics of Travel, Photography, and Life.

feeds.title: The GloveTrotters!
feeds.description: Welcome to The GloveTrotters, a family and boomer travel blog! We're the Glovers - Stuart, Ramie, Sean, and Tiana. We have always loved traveling as a family knowing how vital new experiences are to raising flexible, open-minded, and culturally mindful children.

feeds.title: Solo Travel Girl Blog
feeds.description: Blog by Jennifer Huber, and I am just your average forty-something-year-old gal who travels solo. Empowering others to travel alone, not lonely.

feeds.title: Gr8 Travel Tips
feeds.description: Travel, Health & Fitness Blog For Baby Boomers. A travel blog I began back in 2012, sharing our family travel memories and experiences throughout the year. Offering International Travel Tips, Health & Fitness Inspiration For Mature Adults.

feeds.title: Heather on Her Travels
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Heather, an award-winning travel blogger based in Bristol, UK. This is where you'll find travel inspiration for the 50+ traveller looking for an authentic travel experience with a little luxury. Come along with me to taste the food, explore the culture, go hiking and cycling, experience a luxury cruise or boutique hotel.

feeds.title: Solo Trips And Tips
feeds.description: Hi! My name is Susan Moore and my love of solo travel inspired me to start Solo Trips and Tips blog in late 2013 and become a digital nomad in 2015. Now I enjoy travelling alone while still earning a living from this travel website, all from my laptop. The blog provides advice, guides, and stories about travelling alone.

feeds.title: Boomer 55+ Places to Live and Retire » Boomer Travel
feeds.description: Boomer 55+ Places to Live and Retire shares boomer travel and vacations, places boomers like to visit and travel to in this segment. Here at BoomerPlaces.com, our mission is to connect with the Baby Boomer generation. This blog and website are dedicated to all people over 50 years of age, who are just entering (or have entered) their golden years and have begun thinking seriously about living comfortably and actively in retirement.
